definition: tracemalloc incremental allocations after input IDs exist, including Policy containers, retained metadata and transient Python work; no native acceleration-table allocation or complete process RSS
peak: Observed at every policy step; tracemalloc peak is allocator-tracked peak, not a sum of object sizes
implementation_note: The retained Immediate reference also fills the shared threshold-counter dictionary. This is an implementation cost, not a necessary property of immediate admission.
